W.note: Flat spectrum primitives with a striped blob and a starburst read as Figma-adjacent but generic; the ground gradient ends in a visible hard edge against the body background on mobile and leaves a band at the bottom on desktop.

X.note: The dark glow and staggered overshoot assembly capture Figma's brand energy well, but the five pieces reproduce the Figma logo mark and its exact palette, which breaks the no-logo-copying constraint.

Y.note: A plain light-grey scatter-and-reassemble of the Figma logo itself, with no glow or supporting composition, and an unused backOut easing branch in the code.

Z.note: Pastel canvas of primitive shapes wrapped in Figma-style selection handles that morph into circles, with every property returning to identical start values and a clean reduced-motion still and phone layout.
